need: Close the implementation direction for capability enable/disable controls, bilingual capability presentation, and comprehensive in-plugin documentation.
candidates: UI-only toggles; real runtime-gated Module Registry; external docs only vs integrated Help Center/contextual help.
probe_or_evidence: Owner explicitly approved the proposed architecture after review of PersianGravity 4.1.0 main source. Current source registers all supported capabilities in PGR_Core, has conditional field assets, uses text domain persian-gravityforms, and current shipped documentation/language assets show drift/gaps.
observed_result: Approved design is a real code-defined PGR_Module_Registry with one small pgr_modules state option, default-enabled backward compatibility, runtime registration gated by module state, safe-disable checks for in-use GF fields, bilingual capability labels (fa/en) while ordinary UI uses standard gettext, a Persian/English Help & Documentation product surface plus WordPress contextual help, and CI guards for version/docs/i18n/help consistency.
decision: Select this as the PersianGravity 4.2.0 implementation contract. Keep Admin/System Status/i18n/core infrastructure non-disableable; no custom DB, SPA, service container, or heavy framework. Module toggles must affect actual hooks/field registration/assets, not only dashboard presentation.
reopen_condition: Reopen only on direct runtime/API contradiction showing a module cannot be safely gated with native WordPress/Gravity Forms mechanisms, or if a concrete capability requires a different dependency model.
